== Style pass (2026-10-15) ==
=== Missing data ===
* No card-by-card comparison yet of old Virtual modifiers vs Block-era / current Virtual printings (cut: "This wiki does not yet publish a card-by-card comparison ... A later wiki slice is planned for that work. Until then, treat original PDFs, Block packaging, and current Virtual as versioned layers").
* Spot-check cut from article: early Virtual Luke (V) modifier framing on the 2002-era slips is not the same presentation as Luke-line cards in [[Virtual Block 1]] packaging (illustrative, not a full diff).
* No sourced drop-list of Virtual cards dropped from the legal pool across eras.
* Still open: first-release dates for V5–V6 and V7–V11; Premium Shields legal day.
* Exact date of the starwarsccg.org takeover is still unknown (see [[History of the Players Committee]]).
=== Possibly faulty data ===
* Block reorganization date: "Soft Aug/Sep 2009 announces exist in period channels; use 7 Dec 2009 as the firm PDF stamp" ([https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock1.pdf VirtualBlock1.pdf]). Article still says "September 2009".
* Reset date: this page gives 24 September 2014 (from the wiki Main Page); [[History of Star Wars CCG]] gives 25 July 2014 for the Reset announcement and 25 September 2014 for Virtual Set 0.
* Sets 7–11: the 4 December 2006 "Official text as of" stamp is not proven first release; V8 was on CardVault by 12 December 2004.
=== Marginal cuts ===
* VirtualCards1.pdf returns 403 on the res.starwarsccg.org CDN; use [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards1a.pdf VirtualCards1a.pdf] there, or the [https://web.archive.org/web/20050813215254/http://decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/virtual/VirtualCards1.pdf Wayback copy of VirtualCards1.pdf] for the early framing. No VirtualCards18.pdf exists on the CDN (403).
* Cut "Presentation gap" paragraph: early PDF slips show compact replacement game-text boxes for specific Premiere cards; Block packaging and Current Virtual differ in icons, numbering, legal pools; covered by the "After September 2009" section.
* Cut "HTML / CardVault archival" table (Alpha1 HTML archival pass). Rows duplicating the set index were dropped; extra facts: starwarsccg.org forwarding by 5 July 2009 (HTML); Block 6.3 Mercenaries in the Polish chronology on 15 March 2010 ([https://star-wars.pl/Tekst/1963,Star_Wars_CCG_Virtual_Sets.html star-wars.pl]); V3 downloadable 22 September 2002 (may lag the 20 September legal day by about 2 days).
* Cut editor instruction: "Do not edit Virtual Block hub Date fields here (Sep 2009 / most-likely values stay unless a stronger primary appears elsewhere)."
* Cut "The [[2014 Virtual Card Pool Reset]] is unrelated" (to Fifth Anthology) and "See [[Cancelled Virtual Sets]] for the naming/PDF note" (link kept in See also).
* Removed Sources list: every item is now an inline ref (the PC Virtual Slips item became the previously undefined ref "slips").
